provider.connectionModes: unchanged: one fal API key (apiKey, or accessToken when that is where the key is stored), sent as Authorization: Key <key>; connection proxy settings honored

models.name: Veo 3.1 Lite
models.inputs: text only; aspect_ratio 16:9 | 9:16; duration 4s | 6s | 8s; resolution 720p | 1080p; generate_audio, negative_prompt, safety_tolerance, seed, auto_fix

models.name: Gemini Omni Flash
models.endpoint: google/gemini-omni-flash, or google/gemini-omni-flash/image-to-video with one image
models.inputs: aspect_ratio; duration 3 to 10 whole seconds; at most one image

models.name: Grok Imagine Video
models.inputs: aspect_ratio; whole-second duration; resolution; zero, one or several images

dynamicModels: any other fal video endpoint id (owner/app[/path]; first-party ids get the fal-ai/ owner) or a built-in id with fal_input: its OpenAPI 3 schema is discovered per call (or from a connection-scoped store), metadata.category must end in 'video', and the input is checked against the schema before submit

endpoints.submit: POST https://queue.fal.run/{endpoint} (Content-Type: application/json, X-Fal-No-Retry: 1, redirect manual and refused)
endpoints.status: GET status_url pinned to https://queue.fal.run/.../requests/{request_id}/status (fallback {submit}/requests/{request_id}/status), redirect error
endpoints.result: GET response_url pinned to https://queue.fal.run/.../requests/{request_id} (fallback {submit}/requests/{request_id}), redirect error
endpoints.discover: GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models?endpoint_id={endpoint}&expand=openapi-3.0, redirect error, at most two Retry-After retries of 429/503 up to 5 s
endpoints.cancel: none (the source never cancels a queued request)

exports.adapter: default export of adapter.js (also falVideoAdapter from index.js): { async: true, responseFormats: ["url"], defaultResponseFormat: "url", generate({ model, body, credentials, signal, log }) }
exports.factory: createFalVideoAdapter(jobOptions) with optional { store } for connection-scoped discovered definitions
exports.metadata: FAL_VIDEO_PROVIDER_METADATA, FAL_VIDEO_MODELS, FAL_VIDEO_MODEL_IDS, FAL_VIDEO_PROVIDER_ID, FAL_VIDEO_PROVIDER_ALIASES, FAL_VIDEO_FORMAT, FAL_QUEUE_ORIGIN, FAL_API_ORIGIN
exports.helpers: buildFalVideoRequest, falVideoEndpoint, falBuiltInFamily, canonicalFalEndpoint, discoverFalVideoDefinition, falVideoCompatibilityInput, validateFalVideoInput, runFalVideoJob, falVideoAcceptedJob, falVideoTrackingUrl, falVideoResultUrl, falVideoArtifact
